title: Listen and Choose a Response — Apartment Life

questions.stem: Why are you moving out of your apartment so soon?

options.A: The rent is going up by almost two hundred dollars.
options.B: I'm moving it to the other room.
options.C: At the end of next month.

questions.explanation: A 'why' question needs a reason, and a rent increase gives one. The distractors answer when, use Yes, or use 'moving' differently.
questions.speaker: m6
